name: voidlight-skill-library
description: Seven language-craft skills enforcing 2-layer architecture (standard-library-only domain, framework infrastructure) for Java, Python, Rust, TypeScript, Nuxt, and Next.js, plus a Markdown-to-VDL converter skill and two process skills: prd-craft (PRD-first gate with complexity-scored subagent routing) and craft-router (task to language-craft skill routing). Use when writing or reviewing production code in any of these stacks, converting Markdown knowledge graphs to VDL, or starting any feature or implementation request.
